system_texts: The Project Manager will summarize the discussion and place the summary and notes in the project folder.
The Project Manager will defend the design at the final meeting.
The Industrial Designer will work on the conceptual design and integrate components into the design.
The User Interface Designer will specify the technical functions.
The Marketing Expert will come up with user requirements.
gold_texts: The user interface designer will specify the remote's technical functions.
The marketing expert will research user requirements, using the internet and potentially direct user enquiries.
The industrial designer will develop the working design and bring ideas for discussion at the next meeting.
The project manager will summarize the discussion and place it in the project folder.
